parole.testo: Originally attested in Pre-Islamic poetry, like that of an-Nābighah (c.535–c.604), as being abundant in the land of the Byzantines. Although of uncertain identification, it was a kind of plant with pliable twigs or roots that were deemed desirable for spear-making, later being applied to bamboo. Com

parole.significato: to roll, to roll up, to coil, to wind
parole.testo: An early Semitic borrowing, ultimately derived from Sumerian 𒄥 (gur, “to twist, to wind, to turn”).
